leaks.headline: Where Good Jobs Are Being Lost

cards.title: Missed calls
cards.body: Your team is working. The customer calls. Nobody answers. The customer calls the next company on Google.

cards.title: Unanswered quotes
cards.body: You send the quote, become busy, and never follow up. The customer signs with the company that stayed in contact.

cards.title: Slow administration
cards.body: Employees spend time manually collecting details, forwarding messages, checking statuses, and reminding customers.

system.headline: One System From First Call to Signed Job

steps.title: Information collected
steps.body: The system collects the customer's name, address, service needed, urgency, and photos.

steps.title: Technician alerted
steps.body: The correct technician, dispatcher, or owner receives a complete job summary.

steps.title: Lead tracked
steps.body: The request is recorded in the company's CRM or lead dashboard.

steps.title: Quote followed up

steps.title: Result measured

faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.metaDescription: Answers about how the missed-call and quote follow-up system works, what stays human, and what it does not do.

items.q: Does the AI speak directly to customers?
items.a: The system sends approved messages and collects information. Important discussions remain with your employees.
No. It handles repetitive missed-call and follow-up work. Staff continue handling important conversations and decisions.
The request is escalated using rules approved by your company. The system does not diagnose or provide unapproved safety instructions.

items.q: Can it work with our current phone number?
items.a: This depends on the phone provider and setup. The audit identifies the safest connection method.

items.q: Can it integrate with our CRM?
items.a: The system can be configured around common CRMs, calendars, email accounts, or a separate dashboard. Integrations must be verified during the audit.

items.q: Will customers know they are speaking with automation?
items.a: The messages should clearly represent the contractor's business and should not pretend to be a human employee when that would be misleading.

items.q: What happens when a customer replies?
items.a: The automatic sequence stops or pauses, and the reply is routed according to the contractor's rules.
Not automatically. Pricing changes and discounts require approval.
No. The system improves response and follow-up consistency, but results depend on demand, pricing, reputation, availability, and service quality.
We provide a realistic range after auditing your business — timelines vary with call volume, integrations, and how many workflows are involved.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: How TradeCatch collects, uses, and protects information submitted through this website and the systems we manage.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, company, email, phone number, and answers to qualification questions when you book an audit. We also collect basic analytics data about how the website is used.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to respond to your audit request, schedule and conduct calls, prepare proposals, and — if you become a client — to design and operate your revenue recovery system. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: SMS and email communication
sections.body: By submitting a form on this site, you consent to be contacted by phone, email, or text about your request. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS or email communication at any time.

sections.heading: Data sharing
sections.body: We may share information with service providers that support our operations (such as calendar, CRM, email, or hosting providers) under agreements that require them to protect your data. We do not share your information for third-party marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We retain information for as long as needed to provide our services and meet legal obligations. You may request deletion of your information by contacting us.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting hello@tradecatch.ca.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.metaDescription: The terms governing the use of the TradeCatch website and the revenue recovery systems we design, install, and manage.

sections.heading: Services
sections.body: TradeCatch designs, installs, and manages automated communication workflows (missed-call response, lead qualification, technician alerting, and quote follow-up) for contractor businesses. Services are scoped and priced individually following an audit.

sections.heading: Client responsibilities
sections.body: Clients are responsible for providing accurate business information, approving message content and escalation rules before launch, and ensuring that licensed staff handle diagnosis, pricing, and safety-related decisions.

sections.heading: Service limitations
sections.body: The system does not diagnose technical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, medical, or safety conditions, and does not guarantee any specific volume of leads, bookings, or revenue. Results depend on factors outside our control, including demand, pricing, and service quality.

sections.heading: Fees and payment
sections.body: Setup and monthly management fees are outlined in your proposal and invoiced according to the agreed schedule. Late payment may result in suspension of services.

sections.heading: Cancellation
sections.body: Either party may terminate the management agreement with written notice according to the term specified in your proposal. Setup fees are non-refundable once work has begun.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: TradeCatch is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the system, including missed communications caused by third-party phone, SMS, or software providers.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.metaDescription: Which cookies this website uses, why, and how to manage your preferences.

sections.heading: What are cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and let us understand how visitors use the site.

sections.heading: Cookies we use
sections.body: We use essential cookies required for the site to function, and analytics cookies to understand traffic and improve the website. We do not use cookies for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Managing cookies
sections.body: You can accept or decline non-essential cookies using the banner shown on your first visit, and can change your browser settings at any time to block or delete cookies.

cookieBanner.text: We use cookies to run this site and to understand how it's used. See our Cookie Policy for details.
